channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-lidar
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: LidarKit — via awesome-lidar
item.description: Browser-based viewer and converter for LAS, LAZ, COPC and E57 that decodes files locally with WebAssembly (nothing is uploaded), with ground classification and DEM/orthophoto export.

item.title: ERDI — via awesome-lidar
item.description: Laser rangefinder module and single-point LIDAR manufacturer (905 / 940 / 1535 nm, 9 m to 23 km), headquartered in Chengdu, China. Publishes an open specification dataset where every range figure keeps the verbatim test condition it was measured under.
